claim: <One or two sentences quoting only this run's output: P1's good signature, P2's valid schema and P3's baseline and storage age; the image hash matched SHA256SUMS and DistributionInfo.json, the install and the first launch exited 0, cloud-init created <WSL_USER> (uid 1000) as the default user, W7 read 1000:1000, W5's paired record showed the same uid, distinct namespaces and two active user managers, and F1 met F1's pass condition, F2 printed Linger yes and a user-owned bus socket.>
limitations: One run on one Windows host: a new distribution on the existing WSL kernel and Windows installation, not a new physical machine.
Stage 1 and first boot only: stage 2 (the bootstrap), native sign-in, services and the Windows Terminal PATH proof are not covered.
Sanitized: Windows and Linux user names, home and profile paths and the checkout path are replaced by placeholders; the raw transcript stays private on the host.
jcodemunch_registration records F11's state only: a registration is not evidence that a session or subagent uses jCodeMunch.
The rehearsal block records a separate run on a throwaway name, removed by R1; its observations sit beside this run's, not in place of them.
Synthetic fixture only: placeholders and unrun comparison arms are not upstream tests, new-host acceptance or fresh model/GPU runs.
